resumo: Certo que exit 1 e erro nao bloqueante e que 2 e o codigo de bloqueio, com stderr como motivo. Exagero: 'so o 2 bloqueia' ignora o JSON (decision/continue) e o onFailure:block; e 'bloqueia a acao' depende do evento (PermissionRequest nao honra exit 2).

fontes.trecho: Exit code 1 without valid JSON output is a non-blocking error unless the hook is one whose failure blocks the action, even though 1 is the conventional Unix failure code.
The message that comes with the block is your hook's stderr.

resumo: /goal (introduzido na 2.1.139) e um atalho de Stop hook baseado em prompt: um modelo pequeno avalia a condicao a cada turno; nao e verificacao deterministica, pois o avaliador nao roda comandos. Termina quando atendida, julgada impossivel, erro irrecuperavel, /goal clear, ou sem progresso (sem tool por varios turnos). Stop hook de script e que pode ser deterministico, mas tem teto de 8 continuacoes seguidas.

fontes.trecho: /goal is a wrapper around a session-scoped prompt-based Stop hook. Each time Claude finishes a turn, Claude Code sends the condition and the conversation so far
It doesn't run commands or read files independently, so write the condition as something Claude's own output can demonstrate.
Added `/goal` command: set a completion condition and Claude keeps working across turns until it's met.

resumo: Funciona como porta de qualidade, mas: Stop nao tem matcher (o '*' e ignorado); dispara a cada fim de resposta do agente principal (nao so da tarefa), inclusive conversa; sem checar stop_hook_active, cai no teto de 8 continuacoes seguidas (reinicia com tool call). Timeout padrao 600 s; no Windows roda em Git Bash (ou PowerShell sem Git Bash, onde && e (..) podem falhar). So o echo em stderr chega ao Claude, nao a saida do lint/teste ('acima' engana); sem package.json, bloqueia sempre.

fontes.trecho: after stop hooks have continued the turn eight times in a row, Claude Code overrides the next block and ends the turn.
Defaults: 600 for command, http, and mcp_tool; 30 for prompt; 60 for agent.
Git Bash on Windows, or PowerShell when Git Bash isn't installed.
Runs when the main Claude Code agent has finished responding. Does not run if the stoppage occurred due to a user interrupt.

Hooks de UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart adicionam stdout ao contexto. Hooks bem usados podem reduzir tokens (filtrar saida), mas custo zero e exagero; /goal soma tokens do avaliador.

fontes.trecho: The blocking message comes from the JSON reason or stopReason, or from stderr on exit 2. You see it as a warning in the transcript, and it stays in the conversation
Claude Code adds stdout it treats as plain text to Claude's context.
Evaluation tokens are billed on the small fast model configured for your provider and are typically negligible compared to main-turn spend.
